summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and retail sector impacts, particularly focusing on court decisions and market shifts affecting major companies.

bullets.text: Malayalam actor Sreejith Ravi sentenced to one year in jail for POCSO case.
Madras High Court ruled ED can attach proceeds of crime without proving likelihood of concealment.
P&H High Court ordered Punjab to pay ₹1 lakh to man wrongfully booked in NDPS case involving 550 painkiller tablets.
Walmart's Q3 topline growth impacted by 100 basis points due to Flipkart's festive sales timing change.
NSEL investors received ₹1,950 crore after a 14-year wait, distributed among 5,682 traders under an NCLT-approved arrangement.
